title: How the migration carries an old workflow file's checks.commands list
context: The old loader appended the team's stages.checks.checks.commands to the defaults (format, test, build), so [format, test] still ran build. The migration copies the list as written into checks.yaml commands.from_project_profile, which replaces the defaults, so build stops running. #791's table says copy; AC-56 says exactly as the old fields did.

options.label: Carry the union of defaults and the team list (behaviour unchanged)
